description: A chemical role assignment from a specific compound to an abstract ChEBI role or class, indicating that the compound possesses that chemical role or function. Both endpoints are represented as Compound nodes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the chemical role assignment, using the source database display names.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp when the relationship was created or its source attribution changed.

source_contributions.scope: Chemical role assignments from the ChEBI ontology, linking specific compounds to abstract role or class concepts represented as Compound nodes.
source_contributions.description: ChEBI supplies has-role relationships directed from the compound toward the role it possesses. The role endpoint is an abstract ontology concept rather than a structurally defined compound.
